name: TeamStarWolf - Threat Group: Lazarus Group (G0032)
description: ATT&CK-documented techniques attributed to Lazarus Group (G0032; aliases: Labyrinth Chollima, HIDDEN COBRA, Guardians of Peace, ZINC, NICKEL ACADEMY, Diam). Sourced directly from MITRE's intrusion-set to technique 'uses' relationships in the bundled ATT&CK v19.2 data - this is MITRE's own attribution, not a curated TeamStarWolf mapping. Every row is documented group use (score 100). Absence of a technique does not mean the group cannot use it; it means MITRE has not documented it.
